source_artifact.content_excerpt: Orchestrate permits exactly one top-level Code Review controller per run and raises when a run declares more. A run whose approved contract calls for several concurrent review controllers across many child lifecycles therefore cannot be expressed at all. Found during the Auralis preflight on installed Orchestrate 3.0.7, where an approved ceiling of six concurrent controllers across fifteen child lifecycles was not representable.
